content: {"summary":"On 18 March 2025 payments‑api‑03 logged ~40 PAYAPI‑W0310 errors per second while fraud‑scorer‑01 showed only ~45% average CPU. The pod was throttling 30% of periods because gunicorn started 16 workers (node cores) despite a lower CPU limit, exhausting its quota and delaying fraud scores, which caused the PAYAPI‑W0310 spikes. Raising the CPU limit removed throttling and stopped the errors.","likely_cause":"CPU throttling on fraud‑scorer‑01 due to too many gunicorn workers relative to its CPU limit","confidence":"high","claims":[{"text":"PAYAPI‑W0310 spiked to ~40 per second on payments‑api‑03 on 18 March 2025","evidence_ids":["INC-0024#0"],"quote":"at 15:14 the payments channel flagged a jump in `PAYAPI-W0310` on payments-api-03.prod.internal: about 40 a second"},{"text":"fraud‑scorer‑01 was at 30% of periods throttled despite low average CPU","evidence_ids":["INC-0024#1"],"quote":"fraud-scorer-01 was at 30% of periods throttled"},{"text":"Gunicorn started a worker per node core (16) while the pod's CPU limit was lower, causing quota drain","evidence_ids":["INC-0024#2"],"quote":"WEB_CONCURRENCY was unset ... started a worker for each. The pod's CPU limit is smaller than 16 cores, so ... workers drain the quota"},{"text":"Raising the CPU limit reduced throttling below 25% and stopped PAYAPI‑W0310 lines","evidence_ids":["INC-0024#2"],"quote":"By 15:55 the throttling view on fraud-scorer-01 was below the 25% line and the `PAYAPI-W0310` lines ... had stopped"}],"next_checks":["Confirm current gunicorn worker count matches the pod's CPU limit","Add an alert for throttling percentage >25% on fraud‑scorer pods","Monitor PAYAPI‑W0310 rate after CPU limit adjustment"]}
